summary: Tested Mantenimiento Masivo de Sucursales end to end. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases passed. They cover all 8 actions, validations, the 403 without the special permission and 200 with it, audit_trails UPDATE/DELETE entries, the delete skip with 'Proyecto en ejecución', and the permission catalog. Frontend (admin): the button is disabled with 0 selected and shows 'Acciones Masivas (N seleccionados)'. The master checkbox selects/clears all filtered rows, the 'Seleccionar todas las N sucursales del filtro' link works, and the menu has 8 actions. Group+Brand cascade: brand is disabled until a group is chosen, then only that group's brands show, A-Z. The grid fantasy name and DB marca_id/grupo_economico_id/fantasy_name were updated for 3 RIF. Integrador cascade: app is disabled until an integrator is chosen, then only its apps show; integrador_id/aplicativo persisted. Delete: lowercase 'eliminar' keeps the button disabled; ELIMINAR gives 2 processed and 1 skipped with 'Proyecto en ejecución'. Non-admin kherrera: without the permission, no mass-actions-bar/mass-select-all/row checkboxes; with the permission (re-login) they appear and a tipo_servicio action works; the coord_impl 'Aplicar este campo' checkbox enables its select. The sidebar 'Clientes' group shows for admin and kherrera, and /marcas is reachable. /admin/profiles shows the Clientes group with its 4 submodules and 'Función Especial: Mantenimiento Masivo'.

minor.issue: Payload values are not checked against catalogs: any categoria_comercial string (e.g. 'TEST_MM Cat'), any segment string, and any ejecutivo/coordinator user_id are accepted. A nonexistent user_id sets an empty name.
payload.aplicativo is not checked against the integrator's app_name; the stored value is whatever the client sends.
No limit on the size of client_ids. Each record runs several sequential awaits (dependency counts, propagate_rif), so 'select all N' on a large filter could be slow or hit ingress timeouts.

ui_bugs.issue: After the action runs, onDone clears massSelected, so the result dialog title shows '(0 seleccionados)' next to 'Procesados: N'. Cosmetic: keep the count from when the action started.

action_items: Optional: check categoria_comercial, segment, ejecutivo, coordinator and implementer ids against catalogs/users before writing.
Optional: check that aplicativo matches the integrator's app_name.
Optional: keep the selected count in the result dialog title.
critical_code_review_comments: clients_mass.py: on delete, branches are processed first so a Principal can be freed in the same batch. Correct.
group_brand checks that the brand belongs to the group (returns 400 otherwise) and skips branches with the reason 'Hereda la Marca de su Tienda Principal'. Correct.
SIMPLE_ACTIONS append to inherit_overrides and call propagate_rif only for principals. Behaves as intended.
The audit interceptor writes UPDATE/DELETE trails (entidad_id = client_id) for mass actions. Verified.

For UI tests, log in via the API and set localStorage session_token/user. Use state='attached' when waiting for mass-actions-btn because the /clients grid is heavy.
